source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT Vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS taxi_count
FROM TripVendor
GROUP BY Vendor_id

SELECT 
    medallion,
    COUNT(*) as [trip_count],
    SUM(fare_amount)  as [total_fare],        
    SUM(surcharge) as [total_surcharge],
    SUM(mta_tax) as [total_mta_tax],
    SUM(tip_amount) as [total_tips],
    SUM(tolls_amount) as [total_tolls],
    SUM(fare_amount + surcharge + mta_tax + tip_amount + tolls_amount) as [total_charged],
    AVG(fare_amount) as [avg_fare_per_trip]  
FROM FareDetails
GROUP BY medallion;

SELECT medallion, 
payment_type, 
COUNT(*) as [payment_count]   , 
SUM(total_amount) as [total_paid]      
FROM Payment
GROUP BY medallion, payment_type;

SELECT medallion,
    COUNT(*) as [trip_count],
    SUM(trip_distance) as [total_distance],
    AVG(trip_distance) as [avg_distance]       ,
    SUM(trip_time_in_secs) as [total_trip_time_secs],
    AVG(CAST(passenger_count AS DECIMAL(5,2))) as     [avg_passengers]     ,
    MAX(trip_distance) as [longest_trip]       
FROM TripDetails
GROUP BY medallion;

SELECT medallion,
    COUNT(*) as [trip_count]             ,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(SECOND, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime)) as  [avg_trip_duration_secs],
    MIN(pickup_datetime) as [earliest_trip]  ,        
    MAX(dropoff_datetime) as    [latest_trip]            
FROM TripPic
GROUP BY medallion;

SELECT 
    v.medallion, v.Vendor_id, v.rate_code,
    fd.total_fare, fd.trip_count,
    td.total_distance, td.avg_distance,
    p.total_paid
FROM TripVendor v
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT medallion, SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare, COUNT(*) AS trip_count
    FROM FareDetails GROUP BY medallion
) fd ON v.medallion = fd.medallion
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT medallion, SUM(trip_distance) AS total_distance, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance
    FROM TripDetails GROUP BY medallion
) td ON v.medallion = td.medallion
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT medallion, SUM(total_amount) AS total_paid
    FROM Payment GROUP BY medallion
) p ON v.medallion = p.medallion;
SELECT LastLoadedValue FROM WatermarkControl WHERE TableName = 'TripVendor'
SELECT MAX(LastUpdated) AS NewWatermark FROM TripVendor

SELECT * FROM TripVendor
WHERE LastUpdated > '@{activity('LookupOldWatermark').output.firstRow.LastLoadedValue}'
AND LastUpdated <= '@{activity('LookupNewWatermark').output.firstRow.NewWatermark}'
